app.title: 拼图游戏 & 逻辑拼图, 球球 & 泡泡. 脑筋急转弯 游戏
app.titleVi: Câu đố ghép hình & Câu đố logic, Quả bóng & Bong bóng. Trò chơi trí tuệ
app.descr:
Hexa Block Puzzle!

It helps to train memory and spatial thinking.

You need to find the right place for each figure. You cannot rotate shapes, but you can use the tooltip.

The game has 4 difficulty levels. The higher the complexity, the more figures you need to correctly place in their places.

Good Luck!
